settings.heading: Sharp knives make cooking fun again.
settings.text:
Almost every kitchen has a good knife that has gone dull. It squashes tomatoes, slides off onion skins, and turns dinner into a chore. Most of us mean to get it sharpened "someday."

Whetstones take practice. Pull-through gadgets can chew up an edge. Mail-in services take weeks. So we went looking for the easiest way to get a properly sharp edge at home, and landed on the rolling sharpener: a magnet holds the angle, and you just roll.

Keenroll is a small, independent online shop built around that one tool. We keep it simple: one great product, honest shipping times, real reviews only, and a 60-day guarantee.

settings.title: Honest, always
settings.text: No fake countdowns, no fake "only 2 left," no fake reviews. If we say it, it's true.

settings.title: 60 days to decide
settings.text: Sharp, or it's free. Simple as that.
